axes: right-handed; +Y up; face -Z; positive local X pitch moves hanging hands/feet toward -Z
pivotSpace: local to parent; surfaces local to node; body is actor-local root
rootMotion: Only route adapter translates actor root; local gesture clips have no root motion
binding: Misaki remains staff.graybox; visitors have no economic identity or capability

expressions.eyelids: eyelid-left/right are closed-lid geometry; disabled at rest; animate scale.y or enable only for blink, iris geometry stays on same face; GLB master has scale Y=.001 at rest because glTF has no visibility property; runtime adapter restores scale=1 then disables until blink
expressions.mouth: independent curved mouth; scale/tilt for smile/focus; no head replacement

motion: rigid articulated parts; no skeleton, skins, inverse kinematics or embedded glTF clips
restArms: shoulder→forearm→hand hangs downward; elbow and wrist local rotations blend on authored rest
restLegs: hips at y=.65; knees -.25; ankles -.30; soles .015; foot lift must apply at leg root and joint pitch must be calibrated by adapter
material: Existing IEC sRGB→linear PBR semantic material intent; opaque soft fallback; custom lofts use finite smooth normals; no external image/UV/texture dependency
